errorCodes.meaning: The grant's sessionKey, origin, contextDigest or signingScope does not match what the service stored for the request. The request is declined.
The respond is not signed by the request's lock key.
The decision window has passed, or the request has otherwise ended.
The request has already been approved, declined or cancelled.
The carried grant failed verification, is not from the identified DID or does not name the lock, or the member is no longer active. Deliberately generic. The request is declined.

schema.description: The lock holder delivers the member's signed decision on an out-of-band request by carrying a signed auth/oob/grant document. Issued and signed by the lock key `K_a`. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, parentThreadId, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

grant.description: A complete, signed auth/oob/grant/0.3 Trust Task document, issued by the identified DID and signed by its VTA for `assertionMethod`. The service verifies it as a document in its own right — envelope, proof and payload against that specification's schema — over the members exactly as received: its proof covers every member, so it is deliberately an open object here rather than a typed one a binding could narrow.
